turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Saturday. How is your weekend starting off in Phoenix today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! Well, it started a bit later than I planned. I actually slept in way past my alarm today, so I completely missed out on my usual mug of drip coffee—didn't drink anything at all this morning!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh no! Oversleeping can really throw off your morning routine. It sounds like you really needed the rest, though. Did you have to rush out the door to get to the clinic, or is it a day off?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Luckily, it's my day off! Since I don't have a shift today, I didn't have to do any driving or travel whatsoever. Zero commuting for me today, which was a huge relief after waking up so late.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is a relief! No commute is the absolute best way to handle an accidental late morning. How have things been going with the wedding planning lately? Summer 2028 is a way off, but I'm sure there's always something to do.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's going well! Tom and I have been looking at some potential venues around Phoenix. We're trying not to stress since we have plenty of time, but it's exciting to browse.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Phoenix has some beautiful spots, especially for a summer wedding if you're planning on staying indoors with the AC! Have you been keeping up with that online Italian course you signed up for too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have! I did a couple of modules earlier this week. It's a lot of fun, though matching the pronunciation is definitely a challenge.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm sure you'll get the hang of it! Practice makes perfect. Have you had any time to bake lately? I know your sourdough is usually a big weekend project.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not today, unfortunately. Since I got such a late start, I didn't feed my starter in time to get a bake going. I might try to prep something tomorrow instead.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, sourdough timing can be so precise! By the way, has your roommate been using that new espresso machine a lot? Maybe you can convince them to make you something tomorrow to make up for today's missed coffee.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, they are obsessed with it! The kitchen constantly smells like a coffee shop. I might have to take them up on that tomorrow morning.
